bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
case "$(git remote get-url origin)" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot*) ;; *) exit 51;; esac
stage="$root/.worktrees/video-ui-e60b2076"
sha="be4f34d04d346aa20be1765884186e907780f364"
test "$(git -C "$stage" rev-parse HEAD)" = "$sha" || exit 62
test -z "$(git -C "$stage" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no)" || exit 63
newimage="create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d"
newid="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$newimage")"
mapfile -t ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#ids[@]}" -eq 1 || exit 71
before="${ids[0]}"
oldid="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$before")"
oldtag="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Config.Image}}' "$before")"
case "$oldtag" in create-videobot:local-poll|create-videobot:poll-fresh) ;; *) echo VIDEO_RUNTIME_OWNERSHIP_CHANGED; exit 72;; esac
project="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project"}}' "$before")"
files="$(docker inspect -f '{{index .Config.Labels "com.docker.compose.project.config_files"}}' "$before")"
case "$files" in *,*) exit 73;; *compose.videobot.poll.yaml) ;; *) exit 74;; esac
test -f "$files" || exit 75
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$files" config --quiet || exit 76
rollback_tag="create-videobot:before-video-ui-be4f34d"
if docker image inspect "$rollback_tag" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
 test "$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' "$rollback_tag")" = "$oldid" || exit 77
else
 docker image tag "$oldid" "$rollback_tag"
fi
overrides="$(mktemp -d "$root/.worktrees/video-ui-overrides.XXXXXXXX")"
cat > "$overrides/new.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:video-ui-be4f34d
YAML
cat > "$overrides/rollback.yaml" <<'YAML'
services:
  videobot-poll:
    image: create-videobot:before-video-ui-be4f34d
YAML
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$files" -f "$overrides/new.yaml" config --quiet || exit 78
switched=0
rollback() {
 rc=$?
 trap - ERR
 set +e
 if test "$switched" = 1; then
   docker compose -p "$project" -f "$files" -f "$overrides/rollback.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll >/dev/null
   echo VIDEO_ROLLBACK_ATTEMPTED
 fi
 rm -rf "$overrides"
 exit "$rc"
}
trap rollback ERR
switched=1
docker compose -p "$project" -f "$files" -f "$overrides/new.yaml" up -d --no-build --no-deps videobot-poll
sleep 8
mapfile -t after_ids < <(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project="$project" --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll)
test "${#after_ids[@]}" -eq 1 || { echo VIDEO_POLLER_COUNT_INVALID; false; }
after="${after_ids[0]}"
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$after")" = "$newid" || { echo VIDEO_IMAGE_NOT_APPLIED; false; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$after")" = true || { echo VIDEO_POLLER_NOT_RUNNING; false; }
trap - ERR
rm -rf "$overrides"
echo VIDEO_DEPLOY_VERIFIED=PASS
echo VIDEO_DEPLOY_IMAGE_SHA="$sha"
echo VIDEO_POLLER_COUNT=1
